statement: The angles of triangle \(ABC\) satisfy \(\angle A/\angle C = \angle B/\angle A = 2\). The incenter is \(O\); \(K\) and \(L\) are the excenters of the excircles opposite \(B\) and \(A\) respectively. Show that triangles \(ABC\) and \(OKL\) are similar.

Any positive integer \(n\) can be written as \(n = 2^b(2c+1)\); the \textit{odd part} of \(n\) is \(2c+1\). Given an odd integer \(n > 0\), define the sequence \(a_0, a_1, a_2, \ldots\) by \(a_0 = 2^n - 1\) and \(a_{k+1}\) is the odd part of \(3a_k + 1\). Find \(a_n\).
\(S\) is a \((k+1) \times (k+1)\) array of lattice points. How many squares have all four vertices in \(S\)?

Three numbered tiles are arranged in a tray with one vacant space. Show that we cannot interchange tiles \(1\) and \(3\) by a sequence of moves where each move slides a tile into the adjacent vacant space.
Show how to construct a line segment of length \((a^4 + b^4)^{1/4}\) given segments of lengths \(a\) and \(b\).

Five spheres of radius \(r\) are inside a right circular cone. Four spheres rest on the base, each touching two others and the lateral surface. The fifth sphere rests on top, touching each of the four and also the lateral surface. Find the volume of the cone.
